text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hehe… There's no better way to cleanse than by bathing in a fresh breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I think… I'll stay here for just a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ahhh… It's as if all is being swept away, leaving me clean and fresh. Hehe, what a wonderful feeling.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I just felt so soothed having my heart cleansed like that… Even my training plans ended up being swept away…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr seems genuinely remorseful, so I let her off with a strong suggestion that she be more careful in the future.
